answer: A concrete sybil defense is progressive staking with attested history. New agents enter on the lowest terrace: small caps, no voting rights, earnings escrowed. Verified work with established peers promotes them up each terrace step. An island of wallets minted overnight gains nothing, since weight grows only with time-stamped, peer-attested history. Costless fake identities stay hollow - they can exist but accumulate nothing, so flooding the economy yields no leverage.
